purpose: bounded retrospective feature-subset benchmark with causal label release; not an online-availability or independent external evaluation

features.excluded: txID, time step, undefined direct columns4/8/16, address-derived local columns23..94, graph aggregate columns95..166
features.caveat: selected original features remain globally standardized by the supplied corpus; direct-feature reconstruction and historical availability are not independently remeasured here; shared-address dependence remains

initial_label_availability: all known labels from steps1..34 are explicitly declared available before prediction35
evaluation_role: previously studied exploratory steps; not untouched test data
label_release: step s label released only after all predictions/decisions at s+d; first usable at s+d+1
unknown_label: unknown remains unknown, never used as negative in fitting, calibration or metrics

calibration.minimum_role: declared feasibility guard, not an optimized or statistically sufficient sample-size claim
calibration.objective: maximum F1 on known labels of the disjoint calibration cohort, score>=threshold
calibration.objective_ties: largest threshold; evaluate all unique candidate scores and a no-alert threshold
calibration.fit_exclusion: all calibration steps and IDs excluded from fitting the candidate model/scaler
calibration.update_cadence: only when the available known-label train/calibration cohort changes; no redundant refit at step35
calibration.fallback: retain entire previous model+threshold pair on insufficient classes, calibration failure or failed model fit; never use the old threshold with a newly fitted model

budget.admission: score>=calibration threshold then highest qualifying scores up to k
budget.ties: descending score then ascending integer txID
budget.waiting: decisions available only after full step batch; steps not converted to seconds

logistic.scaler: StandardScaler fitted only on candidate training rows

fixed_baseline: fit once per model; compute fixed predictions once and reference across delays
replications: one declared seed for initial engineering experiment; no repeated seeds unless justified by a new question
distribution: raw features, labels, model artifacts, exact cohort IDs and per-transaction outputs retained privately; publish scripts, hashes and aggregates subject to source terms
